scripts.vendor: pnpm run vendor:mustache && pnpm run vendor:js-yaml
scripts.vendor:mustache: mkdir -p hooks/vendor/mustache && cp node_modules/mustache/mustache.mjs node_modules/mustache/LICENSE hooks/vendor/mustache/
scripts.vendor:js-yaml: mkdir -p hooks/vendor/js-yaml && cp node_modules/js-yaml/dist/js-yaml.mjs node_modules/js-yaml/LICENSE hooks/vendor/js-yaml/
